title: State of matter
prompt: Classify each substance by its most common state at room temperature.
triples: Iron is a metal and remains solid at room temperature.
Oxygen is diatomic gas (O2) under normal conditions.
Mercury is a metal that is liquid at room temperature.
Pure water is liquid at room temperature and pressure.
Helium is a noble gas commonly used in balloons.
Table salt forms a crystalline ionic solid.
